_metadata.description: Core UI strings for The Sims 4 mod (Synapse)

AUTONOMY_DESC_TEXT: Configure background timer-based thought generation for active and nearby Sims:
AUTONOMY_INTERVAL_DESC: Current interval: {minutes} min. Click to change.
BRIDGE_ERROR_DESC: AI Bridge returned an error ({status}). Check the bridge console window.
CHAT_BTN_CREATE_GROUP_DESC: Create a group chat with multiple Sims
CHAT_BTN_GROUPS_DESC: Open or create a group conversation
CHAT_CLEAR_CONFIRM: Chat history with {name} has been cleared.
CHAT_CONTACTS_EMPTY: {name} has no known contacts yet. Meet other Sims first!
CHAT_HISTORY_EMPTY: Message history is empty. Send the first message!
CHAT_WAITING_REPLY: {name} is formulating a response, please wait...
DIAG_DESC_TEXT: Diagnostic tools to verify connection with Synapse Bridge server:
DIAG_TEST_DESC: Sends a test request to Synapse Bridge
EXP_CLASSIC_INSANE_DESC: Restores classic 'Insane' trait behavior to Erratic Sims: thoughts and speech become much more chaotic, surreal, and paranoid
EXP_DESC_TEXT:
Click any item to toggle [ON] / [OFF].
Experimental AI gameplay mechanics:
EXP_WW_MODE_DESC: Configure intimacy behavior upon consent [DO=wicked_sex] (bed/nearby, picker/auto)
GENEALOGY_DESC_TEXT: Configure tracking of relatives and ancestors included in AI context.
GENEALOGY_MAX_TEXT: Enter the maximum number of relatives to include in AI context (1-50):
GENEALOGY_ROW_MAX_DESC: Click to change maximum relatives limit
GENEALOGY_ROW_TYPES_DESC: Configure which family relations to include (parents, siblings, etc.)
GENEALOGY_TYPES_TEXT: Click to toggle tracking for specific relative categories:
GROUPS_NO_GROUPS: You don't have any groups to edit yet.
JOURNAL_DESC_TEXT: Select a Sim to view their recently generated thoughts:
JOURNAL_EMPTY: No thoughts have been recorded in this session yet.
LORE_BTN_DELETE_DESC: Erase current biography for this Sim
LORE_BTN_EDIT_DESC: Open text input dialog to edit backstory
LORE_CURRENT_DESC:
Current biography (sent to AI immediately after traits):

"{lore}"

Select an action:
LORE_EMPTY_DESC:
{name} does not have a personal biography yet.

You can enter important facts, secrets, or backstory. The AI will consider them in every thought generation!

Select an action:
LORE_INPUT_TEXT:
Enter facts, backstory, or secrets for {name}.
This text will be provided to the AI directly after character traits:
MENU_CHAT_FLAGS_DESC: Configure context components for AI Messenger messages
MENU_DIAGNOSTICS_DESC: Check bridge connection and test thought generation
MENU_EXPERIMENTAL_DESC: Experimental options (alien male pregnancy, dialogue pause, Insane trait, WickedWhims mode)
MENU_FLAGS_DESC: Choose which Sim data is included in thought generation
MENU_GENEALOGY_DESC: Configure family tracking (limits and relationship types)
MENU_JOURNAL_DESC: View recently generated thoughts for Sims
MENU_LANGUAGE_DESC: Switch mod and context language (English / Русский)
MENU_LORE_DESC: Configure custom biography and lore for any Sim
MENU_SUMMARIZATION_DESC: Enable/disable long-term memory and dialogue summarization
NOTIF_BRIDGE_OFFLINE: Synapse Bridge is unreachable. Make sure the launcher is running.
WW_MENU_TEXT:
Select how the mod executes intimacy when [DO=wicked_sex] is triggered in chat.
Choose bed vs nearby object, and pose picker vs instant random pose:
WW_MODE_AUTO_BED_DESC: Starts sex on bed immediately with a random animation
WW_MODE_AUTO_NEARBY_DESC: Starts sex on nearest object immediately with a random animation
WW_MODE_BED_PICKER_DESC: Finds a bed and opens WickedWhims pose selector
WW_MODE_NEARBY_PICKER_DESC: Finds nearest object and opens pose selector
